{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute the median and quartiles
median_change = trial_df['biomarker_change'].median()
q1 = trial_df['biomarker_change'].quantile(0.25)
q3 = trial_df['biomarker_change'].quantile(0.75)

# Check how many patients are above median
above_median = (trial_df['biomarker_change'] > median_change).mean() * 100

# Compute the trimmed mean (20% trimmed)
trimmed_mean = np.mean(trial_df['biomarker_change'].clip(lower=trial_df['biomarker_change'].quantile(0.10), upper=trial_df['biomarker_change'].quantile(0.90)))

# Print robust statistics
print(f"Median biomarker change: {median_change:.2f}")
print(f"Q1: {q1:.2f}, Q3: {q3:.2f}")
print(f"Percentage above median: {above_median:.1f}%")
print(f"20% trimmed mean: {trimmed_mean:.2f}")"}
